title: Returns and refunds
text: Headphones and other electronics can be returned within 30 days of delivery in the original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after the return is received.

title: Shipping times
text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within the United States. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and costs 15 dollars. International orders ship in 7 to 14 business days.

title: Warranty
text: All electronics carry a 2 year limited warranty that covers manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not covered. To make a claim, contact support with your order number.

title: Resetting your password
text: To reset your password open Settings, choose Security, then Reset password. A reset link is emailed to you and expires after 1 hour.

title: Payment methods
text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay. We do not accept checks or cash on delivery.

title: Privacy
text: We never share customer data with third parties. Support staff can only discuss an order with the account holder.

title: Support playbook: damaged on arrival
text:
Damaged on arrival: apologise, confirm the order number and arrange a replacement through the replacements team.
